title: Nerd Emoji Sound
blurb: Erm, actually — compressed into audio and ready for immediate deployment. The nerd emoji became the internet's designated weapon against pedantry: somebody corrects a technicality nobody asked about, cites a source in a meme argument, or adjusts their glasses before beginning a sentence with 'well'. This sound arrives to file the response. It works pre-emptively as well as punitively, which is the elegant part. Statistically, somebody within earshot of you right now has earned it and is preparing to earn it again shortly.
origin: The audio embodiment of the 🤓 emoji and 'erm, actually' culture.
